east.prompt:
Create a production animation source sheet for James, the engineer in the supplied two canonical BrineSpace masters. Exactly TWO ROWS of SIX separated full-body bare-headed poses = 12 full bodies, clear transparent gutters. True transparent background, no scenery, cast shadow, aura, debris, marks, labels or text. Match master character anatomy, middle-aged short gray/brown hair, broad stocky normal human body, matte charcoal suit, muted ochre/gold shoulder and engineering details, modest silver knee/shin/boot accents, compact backpack. Wrench remains clearly clipped on belt throughout; no wrench in hand, no tablet, no blowtorch or case. East: strict same right-facing three-quarter side camera as references, face and hands right, boots left in water.
Fixed orthographic game camera and one physical character size across BOTH rows. Detail density must be uniform; never stretch or shrink a pose to fill its cell. Match the prone master leg lengths, compact moderate knee bend and boot dimensions; match standing master's148px-equivalent skull-to-foot anatomy and shoulders. Matte neutral graphite, subdued ochre; avoid purple/magenta, orange color shifts, near-black blobs under arms/backpack, shiny outlines. Subtle arm separation, no self-clipping, one head, two arms, two legs.
TOP ROW = SIX frames of swim distress, a looping troubled breathing swimming motion. Body stays prone at the reference pitch and heading; do NOT stand upright or turn toward camera. Frame0: neutral master prone pose, both hands forward.1: modest uneven reaching, nearer arm slightly bent.2: one glove touches upper chest/collar while other arm steadies forward, head raises only slightly.3: glove leaves collar, reaching outward with controlled concern, shoulders tense.4: both arms sweep a little forward again, knees remain compact.5: returns to neutral master prone posture for loop closure. This is restrained readable motion, not flailing or acrobatics. No bubbles drawn into source.
BOTTOM ROW = SIX ordered dry recover-air frames on same planted boots, THREE-SECOND recovery.0: exhausted mild forward bend, both gloves on upper thighs just above knees, hips stay above knees, no squat or kneel.1: brief breath with tiny shoulder lift in same forward bend.2: easing half upright, one glove on upper chest, other beside thigh.3: another small breath in half upright posture, shoulders settle.4: nearly upright, chest glove lowering.5: exactly neutral upright standing pose like standing master, hands down, feet same planted positions. Progressively ease forward lean, no torso collapse or head scale changes. Keep forearm/elbow natural and tools on belt. Render all full silhouettes with comfortable transparent padding.
